nearly empty on purpose: every case here was authored independently of the
descriptions being measured — they are zone purposes from specs a person wrote —
because a case written from a description measures the description against itself.
Four distinct needs is not a measurement. The file exists so that a real
engagement fills it: each time somebody states a need in their own words and a
person picks the component, that is one case, and it is the only kind of evidence
